title: Canonical restriction numerator comparison intertwines transition sheaf morphisms
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L,F arbitrary module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], s a global section of L, and U an open. Define s_U by inverse restrictionAppIso of the ordinary restriction of s. For every n,b≥0, the sheaf isomorphisms E_n of [def-sc-tensor-power-open-restriction-comparisons] satisfy restrict(mulTensorPowSection(s,F,n,b)) ≫ E_(n+b).hom = E_n.hom ≫ mulTensorPowSection(s_U,F|U,n,b). The transition morphism is the inverse right unitor, tensoring with s^b, associator, and inverse tensorPowAddIso; tensor powers are as in [def-sc-invertible-module]. This is an equality of module-sheaf morphisms, not an assertion about arbitrary global-section equivalences.

source.place: Tag 01CD, lemma-tensor-product-pullback; Tag 01PW, restriction of section tensor powers in its proof. Read from https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CD and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PW.

proof.text: The inverse tensor comparison is determined on every pure tensor over every open. Apply the sheaf tensor universal property to prove naturality and unitor/associator coherence: both composites on a pure tensor are the same ambient pure tensor, by the tensor-morphism, associator and unitor formulas. Equality holds as sheaf maps, without assuming global tensor sections are pure.

Induct on the first exponent of tensorPowAddIso: the zero case is the left unitor and the successor is the associator. The previous coherence identifies the power-addition comparisons. Section-power compatibility is the preceding proved lemma. Expand mulTensorPowSection into its four structural morphisms and use these identities to obtain the displayed equality, in all degrees including zero.

lean.statement:
theorem openRestrictionNumeratorIso_mul (X : Scheme.{u}) (L F : X.Modules)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) (n b : ℕ) :
    let sU : Γ(L.restrict U.ι, ⊤) :=
      (L.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).inv (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s)
    (restrictFunctor U.ι).map (mulTensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) F n b) ≫
        (openRestrictionNumeratorIso U.ι F L (n + b)).hom =
      (openRestrictionNumeratorIso U.ι F L n).hom ≫
        mulTensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection (L.restrict U.ι) sU)
          (F.restrict U.ι) n b
